messages: Andrew is awake at home in Charleston. He is studying Psychohistory, and his library holds 864 books.
Vesper now carries verified walkthroughs for 25 games, including GTA 6, which launched yesterday.
Last night Andrew dreamed 10 dreams, and 6 were painted before morning. His Dream Library holds 463 dreams across 34 nights.
Vesper is tested in the open every half hour. In the latest completed round, Round 57, she scored 1 of 5.
NeuroCore, our study of a learning brain built on a recurrent core, is in its first phase of testing.
Vesper is coming to Xbox. Her Xbox app is built, and we are waiting on Microsoft company verification, with an answer expected around December 1 and release expected in January.
